name: return26-solar-credit
description: Single filer, W-2 60,000 (fed WH 6,000, IL WH 3,000) + a 30,000 residential solar installation (Form 5695). The 30% credit (9,000) exceeds the available tax (5,700), so the allowed credit is LIMITED to 5,700 and 3,300 is unused (informational — §25D(c) carryforward usability after the OBBBA termination is unresolved).
note: Hand-verified against PLACEHOLDER 2025 rules. Taxable 45,000 → ordinary tax 1,000 + 3,600 + 1,100 = 5,700. 5695: 30,000 × 0.30 = 9,000 tentative; limitation 5,700; allowed 5,700; unused 3,300. Tax after credits 0; refund = payments 6,000. IL: net 57,225 × 0.0495 = 2,832.6375 → 2,833; refund 167.
